Pitch Collection

  • CURIE: gmeow:PitchCollection
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/PitchCollection
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/music

A set or multiset of PitchValues derived from a source (a spectrum, a tuning system, an analysis, or a projection). A projection of canonical frame-relative content, not the canonical object itself (Principle 4).

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:InformationObject, gufo:Object

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:PitchCollection as a specialized kind of gmeow:InformationObject, gufo:Object. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
